
This is a dynamic list of Lojban words for Pokémon and related terms. You are free to add new entries to this list, provided you do as good a translation as you know how. The current primary objectives are to complete the first 150 Pokémon and make sure we have a thorough base for talking about them outside of the games.

When adding your own terms, check if your heading has any rules and look at a few nearby terms to make sure you're being consistent.

== Rules for adding new entries ==

*Keep the length of the names to a minimum. With Pokémon themselves, it is of the utmost priority to keep them at ten characters or less, excluding "." at the end of each one, but including "." at the start. If anyone ever [[selci'a sera'a lai pokemon. ranslates an existing ROM into Lojban|selci'a sera'a lai pokemon. ranslates an existing ROM into Lojban]], and opts to use these names, they will thank you dearly.
*All names in this list should be treated as cmene, and thus should end with a consonant (preferably "s", as this is the standard) followed by "."

*Use Lojban root words in translations whenever possible, or biological names of organisms. Otherwise, a phonetic translation of the name is perfectly acceptable.
*Names that do not make logical sense in English, such as "Pikachu" (pikatcus.) cannot be expected to make sense in Lojban; use phonetic translations unless you have a good reason otherwise.

== Pokémon ==

'''Conditions for Pokémon valsi'''

* cmevla and brivla, 12-character limit ({'a} and other apostrophe-vowel combinations count as one character each.)
* cmevla:

** These are being kept because they were made first, and Plastic Raven did a lot of good work on them.
** They need to be checked for bad consonant clusters.

** Try to use lojban roots, biological names, then lastly phonetic translation.
* brivla:

** '''BEGINNERS''': see [https://groups.google.com/d/msg/lojban/s44H7z-4vzg/ONVVC72CcawJ These instructions].
** Good knowledge of fu'ivla morphology will likely be very helpful.

** If someone would make some of these, they could probably fill this with more relevant information.
** We would really like brivla.

Every one of the brivla has the place structure:

== Other terms ==

=== Basic ===


First, direct Pokémon terms: (parentheticals are optional, not advised)

|| '''English'''|   '''Lojban''' | '''implied selbri definition'''

Pokémon|   pokrmone / daskyda'u   |   x1 is a Pokémon [[pocket monster|pocket monster]] of species x2 and level x3

Pokémon species| daskyda'u jutsi  | x1 is a Pokémon species of type(s) x2 with evolutions/family x3

Pokémon trainer| daskyda'u jitro  | x1 is a Pokémon trainer controlling/directing Pokémon (party) x2 in x3 (battle)

Pokédex|   liste be lo'i daskyda'u ku  |   x1 is a Pokédex [[list of Pokémon data]] in order x2 in medium x3 (x1 refers to the catalog, x2 refers to the Pokémon numbering system, and x3 refers to the device)

Level  |   te daskyda'u
